narrative.overview: Devoirs is a school notebook, not a quiz app. The exercise is written on a ruled Seyès sheet and corrected in a teacher's red pen. The shell wears the cover of the notebook the pupil chose; everything else is plain paper and printed type.
keyCharacteristics: White paper, lilac ruling, violet-indigo ink, a red double margin.
Eight selectable cover colours with light and dark values.
Two correction pens: red for error, green for right.
Light and dark themes through html[data-theme], cover through html[data-accent].
Motion limited to the pen writing in and the score ring being drawn.

rules.name: The Two Pens Rule
rules.body: Red means wrong, green means right, and neither is used decoratively.

rules.name: The Cover Rule
rules.body: The cover colour fills only the rail and the primary button, and tints selection and progress. It is never a text colour on paper.

rules.name: The Colour Is Not Alone Rule
rules.body: Right and wrong always carry a glyph and a line style as well.

rules.name: The Hand And Print Rule
rules.body: Cursive only for written lines, titles, the brand label and the score note; controls and explanations are Andika.

rules.name: The Spine Rule
rules.body: The rail's depth comes from an inset darker spine, not a border.

dos: Do write exercise text on the ruled sheet, one ruling square per line.
Do mark selection with tinted paper, an ink border and a tick.
Do pair every red or green with a glyph or line style, and keep tap targets at 3.5rem or more.
Do read every colour from the role tokens so all eight covers and both themes work; pair each cover with its on-colour.
Do keep motion to the pen writing and the ring.
donts: Don't use cursive on controls, option labels or explanations.
Don't use pen red or green for decoration, or the cover colour as text on paper.
Don't fill a selected state solidly with the cover colour; only primary buttons and the rail do.
Don't add confetti, streak badges, or celebratory motion.
